content: How much protein should I eat to build muscle?

Aim for about 1.6–2.2 g of protein per kg of body weight per day. That's the range the research supports for muscle gain. Most people do well around 1.8–2 g/kg. Spread it over 3–5 meals, with roughly 0.3–0.4 g/kg per meal, and keep your total calories slightly above maintenance. 💪

If you tell me your body weight, I'll work out your daily number.
